title: gemma-4-sql experiment variables
description: Configuration variables for the gemma-4-sql 7-backend Cloud TPU & TFRC performance comparison suite across Hugging Face Transformers, native PyTorch, Keras (JAX, TensorFlow, PyTorch), MaxText, and native JAX.

GEMMA_4_SQL_REPO_DIR.description: Filesystem path to the target gemma-4-sql workspace repository.

GEMMA_4_SQL_RESULTS_DIR.description: Local directory where per-cell E0-E4 JSON artifacts, comparison summaries, and LaTeX macros are written.

GEMMA_4_SQL_MODEL.description: Gemma 4 model identifier passed to benchmark, SQL evaluation, and fine-tuning workloads.

GEMMA_4_SQL_BACKENDS.description: Comma-separated list of Gemma 4 TPU backends to evaluate across the comparison matrix.

GEMMA_4_SQL_SUBSUITES.description: Comma-separated list of sub-suites (E0,E1,E2,E3,E4) to execute.

GEMMA_4_SQL_BATCH_SIZES.description: Comma-separated list of integer batch sizes swept in Suite E1 prefill and decode benchmarks.

GEMMA_4_SQL_WARMUP.description: Number of untimed XLA compilation warm-up iterations executed before measured trials.

GEMMA_4_SQL_TRIALS.description: Number of measured steady-state benchmark runs captured per workload cell.

GEMMA_4_SQL_DATASET.description: Dataset identifier or JSONL/DuckDB path passed to Suite E2 SQL evaluation and Suite E3 SFT/PEFT/DPO fine-tuning.

GEMMA_4_SQL_DB_TYPES.description: Comma-separated SQL database engines evaluated in Suite E2 ('sqlite,duckdb').

GEMMA_4_SQL_COMMAND_TEMPLATE.description: Optional custom templated command executed across every selected backend in Suite E4.

GEMMA_4_SQL_REQUIRE_HBM.description: Flag (0 or 1) enforcing fail-fast exit 65 when active TPU HBM or /dev/accel* activity is absent.

GEMMA_4_SQL_RESUME.description: Flag (0 or 1) skipping already-completed valid cells matching the current workspace tree digest.

GEMMA_4_SQL_LOCAL_EXEC.description: Flag (0 or 1) executing suite workloads locally on the current host/worker rather than dispatching over gcloud SSH.

GEMMA_4_SQL_SHM_ROOT.description: Root tmpfs directory used for isolated per-backend uv virtualenvs and shared model caches.

GEMMA_4_SQL_PAPER_DIR.description: Optional manuscript directory receiving copied generated_metrics.tex and optional compiled PDF verification.

GEMMA_4_SQL_RENDER_LATEX.description: Flag (0 or 1) rendering comparison_summary.{json,csv,md} and generated_metrics.tex idempotently without re-running E0-E3.

GEMMA_4_SQL_BUILD_PDF.description: Flag (0 or 1) compiling the target LaTeX manuscript PDF in GEMMA_4_SQL_PAPER_DIR after rendering metrics.

GEMMA_4_SQL_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURES.description: Internal CI flag (0 or 1) enabling hermetic synthetic probe and telemetry fixtures strictly during offline tests.

GEMMA_4_SQL_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) validating configuration and logging planned actions without running TPU workloads.

GEMMA_4_SQL_SKIP_CUSTOM_EXEC.description: Internal flag (0 or 1) skipping custom command template execution during pure synthesis passes.

GEMMA_4_SQL_ENABLED.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating whether the gemma-4-sql experiment suite is enabled in an execution plan.
